propwash.blackbox.tab.dropped: %s samples skipped because the disk was too slow; the log continues at the next I-frame.
propwash.blackbox.tab.enabled.tip: Starts a new log every time you arm and ends it when you disarm. Logs stay on your computer; nothing is sent to the server.
propwash.blackbox.tab.hint.switch: Without a radio switch the blackbox logs every armed flight. Put “%1$s” on a switch in the “Modes” tab to log only while it is on (like the BLACKBOX mode in Betaflight). Without that switch the key %2$s pauses and resumes logging.
propwash.blackbox.tab.hint.switch.unboun: Without a radio switch the blackbox logs every armed flight. Put “%s” on a switch in the “Modes” tab to log only while it is on (like the BLACKBOX mode in Betaflight). In the “Keys” tab you can also bind a key that pauses and resumes logging.
propwash.blackbox.tab.hint.tools: Open the .bbl files in Betaflight Blackbox Explorer (blackbox.betaflight.com) or PIDtoolbox (pidtoolbox.com). The header carries your drone's PIDs, rates and filters under their Betaflight names; the logs report compatibility with Betaflight 4.5.1 so both tools read every field.
propwash.blackbox.tab.intro: Like the blackbox of a Betaflight flight controller: while the drone is armed, Propwash writes every pass of the control loop – sticks, setpoints, gyro, PID terms, motors, battery – to a .bbl log for tuning your drone with real tools.
propwash.blackbox.tab.last.full: Last log ended at the storage limit: %1$s (%2$s)
propwash.blackbox.tab.list.empty: No logs yet – switch the blackbox on, arm and fly.
propwash.blackbox.tab.list.more: … and %s older logs in the folder
propwash.blackbox.tab.open_folder.tip: Opens the propwash/blackbox folder in the game directory.
propwash.blackbox.tab.pruned: %s old logs deleted to stay within the storage limit.
propwash.blackbox.tab.rate.tip: Share of the control loop that is logged, like blackbox_sample_rate in Betaflight. 1/1 logs every pass (2 kHz with the default PID loop, about 4 MB per flight minute) – best for the noise and step response analysis in PIDtoolbox. Lower rates make smaller logs.
propwash.blackbox.tab.state.full: Storage limit reached: this log has ended. A new one starts at the next arm.
propwash.blackbox.tab.state.paused: Paused – switch or key is off; logging continues as soon as you switch it on again.
propwash.blackbox.tab.state.ready: Ready: logs at %s from the next arm.
propwash.blackbox.tab.storage.tip: Largest size of the blackbox folder. Before a new log starts, the oldest logs are deleted until it fits; a single log that reaches the limit ends early.
propwash.blackbox.tab.title: Blackbox
propwash.blackbox.toast.off: Blackbox is off – switch it on in the “Blackbox” tab
propwash.blackbox.toast.switch: The “%s” switch on your radio controls the blackbox
